# Expert Agent Roster: Upscale Brunch Restaurant, Tampa FL

<!-- GENERATED by `python3 tools/team.py roster` from .claude/agents and .claude/skills. Do not edit by hand; edit the agent/skill files and regenerate. -->

Built from the research pack in this folder (see [README.md](README.md)). Every role below is a Claude Code project subagent in `.claude/agents/<name>.md`, and every skill is a project skill in `.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`. Each agent preloads its skills through the `skills:` field in its frontmatter, reads its own `knowledge/<name>/` folder before answering, and runs on the model ("brain") explained in [agent-brains.md](agent-brains.md). See [../CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md) for how to use the team.

**28 agents** across 10 domains, **37 shared skills**, and **2 entry-point commands**.

## 4. Entry-point commands

| Command | What it does | Runs as |
|---|---|---|
| `/ask-experts [your question]` | Entry point that hands any question to the orchestrator for a combined expert-panel answer. | `orchestrator` subagent |
| `/improve-team [what to add or improve]` | Entry point that hands a team change request to the meta agent, which edits agents and skills and re-validates. | `meta-agent` subagent |

## 5. How the team works together

- **Orchestrated panels:** the `orchestrator` takes a question, picks 2-6 experts with the `expert-routing` skill, runs them in parallel, adds a cross-review round when they conflict, and returns one combined answer (`panel-synthesis`).
- **Mandatory reviewers:** money questions go to `fpa-analyst`; seats, square footage, site or alcohol questions go to `liquor-zoning-attorney`; material downside goes to `risk-insurance-advisor`; pay or tips go to `labor-law-advisor`; go/no-go questions go to `engagement-lead`.
- **No deep nesting:** experts set `disallowedTools: Agent`, so only the orchestrator delegates. This stays within Claude Code's limit of 3 subagent levels.
- **Self-maintaining:** the `meta-agent` creates and improves agents and skills, then runs `python3 tools/team.py validate` and `roster` to keep this file in sync.
- **Go/no-go gates** (from [09-risks.md](09-risks.md)) are run by `engagement-lead`.
